limitations: No firmware release notes were found on the MOONS product pages; applied-motion.com could not be browsed statically.
The EDS files carry placeholder defaults (product code 0, revision 0, many configuration defaults 0) and do not prove a drive firmware revision.
No current CANopen manual for TSM/TXM-C was found; their EDS follows the 2010 (920-0025) object layout.
Newer Host Command Reference and 920-0025 revisions are visible only on third-party mirrors; they were not used.
Configuration tools (Stepper Suite, STF Configurator, Step-Servo Quick Tuner, CANopen Test Tool), EPLAN .edz, CAD and brochure files were not downloaded; nothing was executed.
Full normative CiA 301/402 standards not obtained.
No hardware contacted or vendor correspondence.
Public accessibility does not establish redistribution permission.
